artifact_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2F - Forward-Only Paper-Evaluation Protocol Specification

shared_simulation_contract.parameter_modification_policy: STRICT_FREEZE (Zero hyperparameter tuning permitted after prospective start)

B_prospective_data_governance.activation_condition: Explicit human repository owner approval; Prospective calendar start date T_0
prohibited_actions: No access, reading, or processing of sealed Tier 3 observations (>= 2022-01-01)
No retrospective replacement or deletion of recorded prospective market data
No lookahead peeking or intraday order submission

data_feed_specifications.calendar_rules: Strict adherence to official NYSE holiday and early-close schedule
data_feed_specifications.missing_bar_handling: If ticker bar is absent, carry forward previous close; omit new rebalancing orders in that symbol until valid bar arrives
data_feed_specifications.immutability: Daily incoming bar payload hashed with SHA-256 and committed to append-only daily audit log

daily_tracking_metrics: Paired Daily NAV and Portfolio Returns (E0 vs D2)
Daily Component Holdings (Shares and Marked Dollar Value)
Gross Economic Exposure (Sum of 1x Equities + 2x Leveraged ETFs)
Active Regime State (Risk-On vs Risk-Off Defensive)
Order Generation & Fulfillment Ledger (Accepted, Filled, Rejected, Partial)
Realized Transaction Costs and Slippage Paid

preregistered_primary_endpoints.name: Drawdown Reduction Efficacy
preregistered_primary_endpoints.hypothesis: Candidate D2 reduces Maximum Drawdown by >= 5.0 percentage points relative to Frozen E0 during market stress periods (where benchmark SPY suffers >= 10% decline).

preregistered_primary_endpoints.name: Full-Cycle Risk-Adjusted Return
preregistered_primary_endpoints.hypothesis: Candidate D2 maintains a prospective Sharpe ratio within 0.10 of Frozen E0, while achieving a higher Calmar ratio (CAGR / MDD).

preregistered_secondary_endpoints: Regime-Switching Transition Lag and Transition Drag

statistical_hypothesis_testing.method: Paired difference test on daily returns delta_t = R_D2,t - R_E0,t
statistical_hypothesis_testing.standard_error_adjustment: Newey-West Heteroskedasticity and Autocorrelation Consistent (HAC) standard errors with lag L = floor(4 * (T/100)^(2/9))
statistical_hypothesis_testing.minimum_sample_requirement: Minimum 252 prospective trading days (1 full calendar year) containing at least one market drawdown >= 10% before formal inference

E_operational_safety_and_boundaries.labeling: ALL OUTPUTS EXPLICITLY LABELED AS 'PROSPECTIVE RESEARCH SIMULATION — NON-EXECUTABLE'

F_research_governance_and_auditability.audit_ledger_format: Append-only JSON Lines (JSONL) with cryptographic SHA-256 chain
F_research_governance_and_auditability.rollback_and_error_escalation: Any missing data or accounting invariant violation immediately halts prospective stepping and alerts researcher; zero silent state repairs
F_research_governance_and_auditability.publication_and_promotion_gate: Candidate D2 may only be considered for production promotion if it successfully clears all preregistered endpoints on the full prospective sample AND passes an independent peer audit.
